questions.explanationZh: BC 把收缩压低于 90 毫米汞柱列为 CPAP 的禁忌证，因为胸内压升高会减少静脉回流、加重低血压（C）。应给高流量氧，自主呼吸不足时用球囊面罩通气；收缩压低于 90 时也不要加 PEEP 阀。A 错：起始压力低并不能消除禁忌。B 错：快速输液会加重肺水肿，BC 也没有「先补液再上 CPAP」的做法。D 错：压力越高血压降得越多，而且 10 厘米水柱是上限，不是起点。

questions.questionEn: How does CPAP improve oxygenation?
questions.questionZh: CPAP是通过什么机制改善氧合的？

options.en: It raises functional residual capacity and alveolar surface area
options.zh: 增加功能残气量和肺泡表面积

options.en: It delivers a set tidal volume regardless of patient effort
options.zh: 不论患者是否用力，都输送设定的潮气量

options.en: It chemically increases hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen
options.zh: 以化学方式提高血红蛋白对氧的亲和力

options.en: It slows breathing by sedating the respiratory centre
options.zh: 通过抑制呼吸中枢让呼吸变慢

questions.explanationEn: BC describes CPAP as a non-invasive way to increase oxygen diffusion across the alveolar membrane by increasing functional residual capacity and alveolar surface area, which lowers the work of breathing and oxygen consumption while improving oxygen supply; it reduces intubation rates and mortality (A). B is wrong: delivering a set tidal volume is what a ventilator or BVM does; CPAP depends on the patient breathing spontaneously. C is wrong: CPAP has no chemical effect on hemoglobin. D is wrong: CPAP does not sedate; any fall in respiratory rate comes from reduced work of breathing.
questions.explanationZh: BC 对 CPAP 的描述是：一种无创方法，通过增加功能残气量和肺泡表面积来提高氧气跨肺泡膜的弥散，从而降低呼吸做功和氧耗、改善供氧，并可降低插管率和死亡率（A）。B 错：输送设定潮气量是呼吸机或球囊面罩的功能，CPAP 依赖患者自主呼吸。C 错：CPAP 对血红蛋白没有化学作用。D 错：CPAP 没有镇静作用，呼吸频率下降是因为呼吸做功减轻。

questions.questionEn: You are ventilating a 44-year-old near-drowning patient with a BVM. His SpO2 stays at 89% despite 15 L/min and a good mask seal. He has no contraindications. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 你正在为一名44岁溺水患者进行球囊面罩通气。尽管氧流量15升/分且面罩密封良好，SpO2仍停留在89%。他没有禁忌证。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Switch to CPAP at 10 cmH2O instead of bagging him
options.zh: 改用 10 厘米水柱 CPAP，不再捏球囊

options.en: Add a 5 cmH2O PEEP valve; ventilate 8–10 times/min
options.zh: 加 5 厘米水柱 PEEP 阀，每分钟 8–10 次

options.en: Ventilate faster, at about 20 breaths per minute
options.zh: 加快通气频率，约每分钟 20 次

options.en: Remove the mask and apply a non-rebreather at 15 L/min
options.zh: 取下面罩，改用 15 升/分非再呼吸面罩

questions.explanationEn: When a patient needs BVM ventilation and has no contraindication, BC adds a PEEP valve to raise the SpO2 to 94% or more: attach it to the exhaust port, set 5 cmH2O, keep a good seal, ventilate no more than 8–10 breaths per minute, and increase by 2.5 cmH2O to a maximum of 10 while watching SpO2 and blood pressure (B); the drowning guideline also directs PEEP or CPAP if indicated. A is wrong: a patient who needs assisted ventilation is not a CPAP candidate, and CPAP starts at 5 cmH2O. C is wrong: hyperventilation raises intrathoracic pressure and must be avoided. D is wrong: a non-rebreather does not ventilate.
questions.explanationZh: 需要球囊面罩通气且无禁忌证时，BC 要求加用 PEEP 阀，把 SpO2 提升到 94% 以上：接在排气口，设为 5 厘米水柱，保持面罩密封，每分钟通气不超过 8–10 次，可每次加 2.5 厘米水柱、最高 10，并观察 SpO2 和血压（B）；BC 溺水指南也写明有指征时用 PEEP 或 CPAP。A 错：需要辅助通气的患者不适合 CPAP，而且 CPAP 从 5 厘米水柱起步。C 错：过度通气会升高胸内压，必须避免。D 错：非再呼吸面罩不能通气。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old man being ventilated with a BVM and a PEEP valve at 7.5 cmH2O suddenly becomes hypotensive with a systolic BP of 82 mmHg. What is the immediate action?
questions.questionZh: 一名79岁男性正在使用球囊面罩配7.5厘米水柱PEEP阀通气，突然出现低血压，收缩压82毫米汞柱。应立即采取什么措施？

options.en: Increase PEEP to 10 cmH2O to improve oxygenation
options.zh: 将PEEP升至10厘米水柱以改善氧合

options.en: Reduce PEEP to 5 cmH2O and continue
options.zh: 将PEEP降至5厘米水柱后继续

options.en: Remove the PEEP valve
options.zh: 移除PEEP阀

options.en: Stop ventilating and apply CPAP instead
options.zh: 停止通气，改用CPAP

questions.explanationEn: BC directs removing the PEEP valve if the patient becomes hypotensive (systolic below 90) or goes into cardiac arrest, because PEEP raises intrathoracic pressure and reduces venous return and cardiac output (C). A is wrong: more PEEP would lower his blood pressure further. B is wrong: BC says to remove the valve, not to step it down. D is wrong: he still needs ventilation, and CPAP is contraindicated with a systolic below 90 and in a patient who cannot maintain his own respiratory effort.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定：患者出现低血压（收缩压低于 90）或心脏骤停时，要移除 PEEP 阀，因为 PEEP 会升高胸内压，减少静脉回流和心输出量（C）。A 错：再加 PEEP 只会让血压更低。B 错：BC 要求移除，不是调低。D 错：他仍需要通气，而且收缩压低于 90 以及无法维持自主呼吸都是 CPAP 的禁忌证。

questions.questionEn: When a PCP adds a PEEP valve to a bag-valve mask, what are the correct starting setting, adjustment and maximum?
questions.questionZh: PCP 在球囊面罩上加用 PEEP 阀时，正确的起始值、调整幅度和上限分别是多少？

options.en: Start at 5 cmH2O, raise in 2.5 cmH2O steps, maximum 10
options.zh: 起始 5 厘米水柱，每次加 2.5，最高 10

options.en: Start at 10 cmH2O, lower in 2.5 cmH2O steps, minimum 5
options.zh: 起始 10 厘米水柱，每次减 2.5，最低 5

options.en: Start at 5 cmH2O, raise in 5 cmH2O steps, maximum 20
options.zh: 起始 5 厘米水柱，每次加 5，最高 20

options.en: Start at 2.5 cmH2O, raise in 2.5 cmH2O steps, maximum 15
options.zh: 起始 2.5 厘米水柱，每次加 2.5，最高 15

questions.explanationEn: BC sets the PEEP valve at 5 cmH2O on the BVM exhaust port, with a good seal and no more than 8–10 breaths per minute; it may be increased in 2.5 cmH2O increments to a maximum of 10 cmH2O while monitoring SpO2 and blood pressure, and it is removed if the systolic falls below 90 or the patient arrests (A). B is wrong: PEEP starts low and is titrated up, not started at the maximum. C is wrong: the steps are 2.5, not 5, and 20 cmH2O far exceeds the BC maximum. D is wrong: the starting setting is 5, not 2.5, and 15 cmH2O exceeds the BC maximum even though it appears on the device table.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定 PEEP 阀接在球囊面罩排气口，设为 5 厘米水柱，保持密封，每分钟通气不超过 8–10 次；可每次加 2.5 厘米水柱，最高 10，同时监测 SpO2 和血压；收缩压低于 90 或心脏骤停时要移除（A）。B 错：PEEP 要从低值开始往上滴定，不是从上限开始。C 错：每档是 2.5 不是 5，20 厘米水柱远超 BC 上限。D 错：起始值是 5 不是 2.5，15 厘米水柱虽然出现在设备对照表上，但超过了 BC 上限。

questions.questionEn: A 70-year-old woman with severe COPD is nauseated and has vomited twice in the last 10 minutes. She is dyspneic with RR 28 and SpO2 90% on oxygen, and is awake. What is the correct decision regarding CPAP?
questions.questionZh: 一名70岁重度COPD女性恶心并在过去10分钟内呕吐两次。她呼吸困难，呼吸28次/分，吸氧下SpO2为90%，神志清醒。关于CPAP的正确决定是什么？

options.en: Apply CPAP and keep suction ready in case she vomits
options.zh: 上 CPAP，并备好吸引器以防她再吐

options.en: Withhold CPAP: active vomiting is a contraindication
options.zh: 不用 CPAP：正在呕吐是禁忌证

options.en: Apply CPAP now and give an antiemetic at the same time
options.zh: 立即上 CPAP，同时给止吐药

options.en: Apply CPAP but limit the pressure to 5 cmH2O
options.zh: 上 CPAP，但把压力限制在 5 厘米水柱

questions.explanationEn: BC lists vomiting or any other risk of aspiration as a contraindication to CPAP: the sealed mask traps vomitus and positive pressure can drive it into the airway (B). Continue the oxygen escalation, position her for comfort and airway protection, consider an antiemetic (dimenhydrinate or ondansetron) as a PCP, and ventilate by BVM if her effort fails. A is wrong: having suction ready does not make CPAP safe while she is vomiting. C is wrong: an antiemetic does not remove the immediate aspiration risk, so CPAP remains contraindicated. D is wrong: a lower pressure does not remove the contraindication.
questions.explanationZh: BC 把呕吐或任何误吸风险列为 CPAP 的禁忌证：密封的面罩会困住呕吐物，正压还可能把它压进气道（B）。应继续按顺序升级给氧，摆好兼顾舒适和气道保护的体位；作为 PCP 可考虑止吐药茶苯海明（dimenhydrinate）或昂丹司琼（ondansetron）；如果自主呼吸不足，就用球囊面罩通气。A 错：备好吸引器并不能让正在呕吐的患者安全使用 CPAP。C 错：止吐药不能立刻消除误吸风险，CPAP 仍属禁忌。D 错：降低压力也消除不了禁忌。

questions.questionEn: An 81-year-old man with known CHF has crackles to the mid-chest bilaterally, RR 26, SpO2 89% on room air. How should he be positioned?
questions.questionZh: 一名81岁已知心衰男性双肺中部以下可闻及湿啰音，呼吸26次/分，未吸氧SpO2为89%。应如何摆放体位？

options.en: Sitting upright with the legs hung down
options.zh: 端坐位，双腿下垂

options.en: Supine with the legs elevated
options.zh: 仰卧并抬高双腿

options.en: Left lateral recovery position
options.zh: 左侧卧复原体位

options.en: Prone to improve posterior lung recruitment
options.zh: 俯卧以改善背侧肺复张

questions.explanationEn: For CHF or pulmonary edema, BC positions the patient sitting upright with the legs hung down, which pools blood in the legs, reduces venous return to the congested lungs and eases breathing; keep him at rest and warm, with oxygen to SpO2 94% or higher (A). B is wrong: supine with legs elevated increases venous return and worsens pulmonary congestion; it is a shock position. C is wrong: the lateral recovery position is for airway protection in a patient with decreased LOC, not for an alert patient in pulmonary edema. D is wrong: prone positioning is not part of BC prehospital CHF care and would make his breathing harder.
questions.explanationZh: 对心衰或肺水肿，BC 要求让患者端坐、双腿下垂：血液积在下肢，回到充血肺部的静脉血减少，呼吸会轻松些；同时保持休息、保暖，给氧使 SpO2 ≥94%（A）。B 错：仰卧抬腿会增加静脉回流、加重肺充血，那是休克体位。C 错：侧卧复原体位用于意识下降患者的气道保护，不适用于清醒的肺水肿患者。D 错：俯卧不属于 BC 院前心衰处理，只会让他呼吸更费力。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old woman with pulmonary edema is on the third floor with no elevator. She is dyspneic at rest with SpO2 88%. What is the most appropriate approach to extrication?
questions.questionZh: 一名79岁肺水肿女性住在没有电梯的三楼。她静息时即呼吸困难，SpO2为88%。最合适的转运方式是什么？

options.en: Walk her down slowly with oxygen to save time
options.zh: 让她戴着氧气慢慢走下楼，以节省时间

options.en: Walk her to the landing, then carry her from there
options.zh: 让她自己走到楼梯平台，再从那里抬下去

options.en: Keep her at rest; bring lifting and transfer devices to her
options.zh: 让她保持休息，把搬运和转移设备带到她身边

options.en: Delay moving her until her SpO2 is 94% on room air
options.zh: 等她不吸氧 SpO2 达到 94% 再搬动

questions.explanationEn: For CHF or pulmonary edema, BC directs keeping the patient at rest and avoiding exertion during transfers by bringing equipment, including lifting and transfer devices, to the patient (C). A and B are wrong: any walking raises myocardial oxygen demand and can precipitate rapid deterioration in a patient already hypoxic at rest. D is wrong: she is unlikely to reach 94% on room air without treatment, and delaying transport keeps her from definitive care; give oxygen (and consider CPAP as a PCP) and move her without exertion.
questions.explanationZh: 对心衰或肺水肿患者，BC 要求让患者保持休息，搬运时避免用力，把包括搬运和转移设备在内的器材带到患者身边（C）。A、B 错：走路会增加心肌耗氧，对一个静息时就缺氧的患者，可能诱发病情急剧恶化。D 错：不经治疗她很难在不吸氧时达到 94%，推迟转运只会耽误确定性治疗；应给氧（作为 PCP 可考虑 CPAP），并在她不用力的情况下转运。

questions.questionEn: A 58-year-old man pulled from a lake is breathing spontaneously but has frothy sputum, an altered level of consciousness and SpO2 of 86% on high-flow oxygen. What does the BC guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 一名58岁男性从湖中被救出，有自主呼吸但口吐泡沫痰、意识状态改变，高流量吸氧下SpO2为86%。BC指南要求怎么做？

options.en: Withhold ventilatory support, since he is breathing on his own
options.zh: 不给通气支持，因为他还有自主呼吸

options.en: Lay him flat to help fluid drain from his lungs
options.zh: 让他平躺，帮助肺里的液体流出

options.en: Assist his ventilations by BVM, considering a PEEP valve
options.zh: 用球囊面罩辅助通气，考虑加 PEEP 阀

options.en: Apply CPAP at 10 cmH2O despite his altered LOC
options.zh: 不管意识改变，直接给 10 厘米水柱 CPAP

questions.explanationEn: Drowning is listed under the BC CHF/pulmonary edema guideline, which directs assisting ventilations if the patient has an altered LOC or an SpO2 below 94%; PCPs consider a PEEP valve starting at 5 cmH2O, and the drowning guideline calls for positive pressure ventilation to support failing respirations (C). A is wrong: spontaneous breathing does not rule out the need for support; altered LOC and 86% on high-flow oxygen mean his breathing is failing. B is wrong: lying flat does not drain alveolar fluid, and BC sits conscious drowning and pulmonary edema patients up; an altered-LOC patient needs airway control and ventilation. D is wrong: CPAP is contraindicated with a decreased LOC or inability to follow commands, and it starts at 5 cmH2O.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的心衰/肺水肿指南把溺水列为适应证，并规定意识改变或 SpO2 低于 94% 时要辅助通气；PCP 可考虑加 PEEP 阀，从 5 厘米水柱开始；溺水指南也要求用正压通气支持衰竭的呼吸（C）。A 错：有自主呼吸不代表不需要支持；意识改变、高流量吸氧下 SpO2 仍只有 86%，说明呼吸正在衰竭。B 错：平躺并不能把肺泡里的液体排出来，BC 对清醒的溺水和肺水肿患者是让其坐起；意识改变的患者需要的是气道控制和通气。D 错：意识下降或无法听从指令是 CPAP 的禁忌证，而且 CPAP 从 5 厘米水柱起步。

questions.questionEn: A 67-year-old man has crushing substernal chest pain radiating to his left arm, BP 138/84, HR 88, SpO2 96% on room air. He has taken no medication. What should be administered first?
questions.questionZh: 一名67岁男性有压榨性胸骨后疼痛并向左臂放射，血压138/84，心率88，未吸氧SpO2 96%。他尚未服用任何药物。首先应给予什么？

options.en: Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL, before any other drug
options.zh: 先舌下含服硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）0.4 毫克

options.en: ASA 160 mg, chewed and swallowed
options.zh: 阿司匹林（ASA）160 毫克，嚼碎吞服

options.en: Entonox, self-administered for the pain
options.zh: 让患者自行吸入 Entonox（笑气，氧化亚氮/氧气混合气）止痛

options.en: Salbutamol 5 mg by nebulizer
options.zh: 雾化吸入沙丁胺醇（salbutamol）5 毫克

questions.explanationEn: The BC cardiac chest pain protocol runs: position of comfort, primary survey with oxygen only as needed to keep SpO2 at 94% or higher (none needed at 96%), ASA 160 mg chewed and swallowed if not already taken, initiate transport, history and vitals, then nitroglycerin if appropriate (B). ASA is also the only BC medication that does not require vital signs first. A is wrong: nitroglycerin follows ASA and requires vitals (SBP above 110, HR 50–150); it is appropriate here, but second. C is wrong: Entonox is for pain that persists after 3 nitroglycerin doses or when the SBP falls below 110. D is wrong: salbutamol treats bronchospasm, and he has no wheeze.
questions.explanationZh: BC 心源性胸痛方案的顺序是：舒适体位，完成初级评估并按需给氧使 SpO2 ≥94%（96% 时无需给氧），如未自行服用则给阿司匹林（ASA）160 毫克嚼碎吞服，启动转运，采集病史和生命体征，然后在合适时给硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）（B）。阿司匹林也是 BC 唯一一种给药前不必先测生命体征的药物。A 错：硝酸甘油排在阿司匹林之后，而且需要先测生命体征（收缩压 >110、心率 50–150）；本例可以用，但应在第二步。C 错：Entonox（笑气，氧化亚氮/氧气混合气）用于 3 剂硝酸甘油后疼痛仍持续，或收缩压降到 110 以下时。D 错：沙丁胺醇（salbutamol）治疗支气管痉挛，他没有哮鸣。

questions.questionEn: What is the dose and route of Aspirin (ASA) for suspected cardiac ischemia under the BC guidelines?
questions.questionZh: 按 BC 指南，疑似心肌缺血时阿司匹林（ASA）的剂量和给药方法是什么？

options.en: 325 mg PO, swallowed whole with water
options.zh: 口服 325 毫克，用水整片吞服

options.en: 80 mg PO, then 80 mg daily
options.zh: 口服 80 毫克，之后每天 80 毫克

options.en: 160 mg PO, chewed and swallowed
options.zh: 口服 160 毫克，嚼碎后吞服

options.en: 650 mg PO, chewed and swallowed
options.zh: 口服 650 毫克，嚼碎后吞服

questions.explanationEn: BC gives ASA 160 mg PO, chewed and swallowed, with an onset of 20 minutes to an hour when chewed (C). A is wrong: 325 mg is not the BC dose, and swallowing a tablet whole slows absorption. B is wrong: 80 mg is a daily maintenance dose, not the acute prehospital dose. D is wrong: 650 mg is an analgesic dose, far above the BC antiplatelet dose. Textbook (Nancy) wording differs: it gives 160–325 mg of non-enteric-coated ASA to chew, whereas the BC exam uses 160 mg.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定阿司匹林（ASA）160 毫克口服，嚼碎后吞服，嚼服后 20 分钟至 1 小时起效（C）。A 错：325 毫克不是 BC 剂量，整片吞服吸收也慢。B 错：80 毫克是日常维持量，不是院前急性期剂量。D 错：650 毫克是镇痛剂量，远高于 BC 的抗血小板剂量。教材（Nancy）写法不同：嚼服 160–325 毫克非肠溶阿司匹林，而 BC 考试按 160 毫克。

questions.questionEn: A 74-year-old woman with chest pain tells you she has an active peptic ulcer and was recently treated for a GI bleed. Her BP is 142/88. What should you do about ASA?
questions.questionZh: 一名 74 岁胸痛女性告诉你，她有活动性消化性溃疡，最近还因消化道出血接受过治疗。血压 142/88。阿司匹林（ASA）该怎么处理？

options.en: Give 160 mg, since the cardiac benefit outweighs the risk
options.zh: 给 160 毫克，因为心脏获益大于风险

options.en: Give a reduced dose of 80 mg to lower the bleeding risk
options.zh: 减量给 80 毫克，以降低出血风险

options.en: Give it anyway, as an ulcer is only a caution
options.zh: 照常给，因为溃疡只是注意事项

options.en: Withhold it: an active ulcer or GI bleed is a contraindication
options.zh: 不给：活动性溃疡或消化道出血是禁忌证

questions.explanationEn: BC lists active peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding as a contraindication to ASA, alongside inability to swallow, allergy, having already taken the recommended dose, salicylate- or NSAID-induced asthma, and paediatric patients with viral symptoms (D). The rest of the chest pain protocol still applies. A is wrong: a contraindication is not weighed against benefit in the prehospital protocol. B is wrong: BC has no reduced ASA dose. C is wrong: recent internal bleeding and anticoagulant use are cautions, but an active ulcer or GI bleed is a contraindication.
questions.explanationZh: BC 把活动性消化性溃疡或消化道出血列为阿司匹林（ASA）的禁忌证，其他禁忌还有无法吞咽、过敏、已自行服用推荐剂量、水杨酸类或非甾体抗炎药诱发的哮喘，以及有病毒感染症状的儿童（D）。胸痛方案的其余部分照常执行。A 错：院前方案中，禁忌证不拿来和获益权衡。B 错：BC 没有减量的阿司匹林剂量。C 错：近期内出血、正在用抗凝药是注意事项，但活动性溃疡或消化道出血是禁忌证。

questions.questionEn: What is the correct dose and dosing interval for sublingual nitroglycerin in cardiac chest pain?
questions.questionZh: 心源性胸痛时，舌下含服硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）的正确剂量和给药间隔是什么？

options.en: 0.4 mg SL every 3–5 min while the SBP stays above 110
options.zh: 每 3–5 分钟舌下 0.4 毫克，收缩压需保持 >110

options.en: 0.8 mg SL every 5 min while the SBP stays above 90
options.zh: 每 5 分钟舌下 0.8 毫克，收缩压需保持 >90

options.en: 0.4 mg SL every 10 min, up to 5 doses
options.zh: 每 10 分钟舌下 0.4 毫克，最多 5 剂

options.en: 0.3 mg SL once only, then transport
options.zh: 舌下 0.3 毫克只给一次，然后转运

questions.explanationEn: BC gives nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL every 3–5 minutes, provided the systolic BP remains above 110, until pain-free, to a maximum of 3 doses in any 30-minute period; onset is about 60 seconds and duration about 30 minutes (A). B is wrong: it doubles the dose and uses a threshold of 90 instead of 110. C is wrong: the interval is too long and 5 doses exceeds the BC limit of 3 per 30 minutes. D is wrong: the BC dose is 0.4 mg and may be repeated. Textbook (Nancy) wording differs: it gives 0.3–0.4 mg every 5 minutes for 3 to 6 doses, whereas the BC exam uses 0.4 mg every 3–5 minutes to a maximum of 3 doses in 30 minutes.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）每 3–5 分钟舌下 0.4 毫克，前提是收缩压保持在 110 以上，直到疼痛消失，任何 30 分钟内最多 3 剂；约 60 秒起效，作用约 30 分钟（A）。B 错：剂量加倍，而且用 90 代替了 110 的门槛。C 错：间隔太长，5 剂也超过了 BC 每 30 分钟最多 3 剂的限制。D 错：BC 剂量是 0.4 毫克，可以重复。教材（Nancy）写法不同：0.3–0.4 毫克每 5 分钟一次、共 3–6 剂，而 BC 考试按 0.4 毫克每 3–5 分钟、30 分钟内最多 3 剂。

questions.questionEn: A 70-year-old man with chest pain has a BP of 104/68, HR 76. He has had ASA. What about nitroglycerin?
questions.questionZh: 一名 70 岁胸痛男性血压 104/68，心率 76，已服阿司匹林（ASA）。硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）该怎么处理？

options.en: Give 0.4 mg SL, since the systolic is above 90
options.zh: 舌下给 0.4 毫克，因为收缩压高于 90

options.en: Give a half dose of 0.2 mg SL
options.zh: 舌下给半量 0.2 毫克

options.en: Withhold it: a systolic below 110 is a contraindication
options.zh: 不给：收缩压低于 110 是禁忌证

options.en: Give it after a 500 mL fluid bolus raises the BP
options.zh: 先输 500 毫升液体升压，再给

questions.explanationEn: BC contraindicates nitroglycerin when the systolic BP is below 110 mmHg; other contraindications are nitrate allergy or sensitivity, HR below 50 or above 150, and Viagra or Levitra within 24 hours or Cialis within 48 hours (C). With an SBP below 110, the protocol moves to Entonox for persistent pain. A is wrong: 90 is not the BC threshold for nitroglycerin. B is wrong: BC has no half dose. D is wrong: giving fluid to make a patient eligible for nitroglycerin is not part of the BC protocol.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定收缩压低于 110 毫米汞柱时禁用硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）；其他禁忌包括硝酸盐过敏或不耐受、心率低于 50 或高于 150，以及 24 小时内用过万艾可（Viagra）或艾力达（Levitra）、48 小时内用过希爱力（Cialis）（C）。收缩压低于 110 时，持续的胸痛按方案改用 Entonox（笑气，氧化亚氮/氧气混合气）。A 错：90 不是 BC 硝酸甘油的门槛。B 错：BC 没有半量用法。D 错：为了能用硝酸甘油而先补液升压，不在 BC 方案里。

questions.questionEn: A 56-year-old man has chest pain, BP 128/78, HR 82. He mentions he took a Cialis tablet about 30 hours ago. What is the correct decision?
questions.questionZh: 一名 56 岁男性胸痛，血压 128/78，心率 82。他提到大约 30 小时前吃过一片希爱力（Cialis）。正确的决定是什么？

options.en: Withhold nitroglycerin: Cialis was taken within 48 hours
options.zh: 不给硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）：48 小时内用过希爱力

options.en: Give nitroglycerin, as more than 24 hours have passed
options.zh: 给硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），因为已超过 24 小时

options.en: Give nitroglycerin at half the usual dose
options.zh: 按常规剂量的一半给硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）

options.en: Give it only if the systolic BP is above 150 mmHg
options.zh: 只有收缩压高于 150 时才给

questions.explanationEn: BC's contraindication window depends on the drug: Viagra or Levitra within 24 hours, but Cialis within 48 hours. At 30 hours after Cialis, nitroglycerin is contraindicated because of the risk of profound hypotension (A). B is wrong: the 24-hour window applies to Viagra and Levitra, not Cialis. C is wrong: BC has no reduced dose to get around a contraindication. D is wrong: a higher blood pressure does not override the PDE-5 inhibitor contraindication. Textbook (Nancy) wording differs: its table lists tadalafil (Cialis) effects lasting 36–72 hours; either way, 30 hours is inside the window.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的禁忌时间窗因药而异：万艾可（Viagra）或艾力达（Levitra）为 24 小时内，希爱力（Cialis）为 48 小时内。服用希爱力 30 小时后仍属禁忌，给硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）有引起严重低血压的风险（A）。B 错：24 小时窗口适用于万艾可和艾力达，不适用于希爱力。C 错：BC 没有用减量来绕过禁忌的做法。D 错：血压再高也不能抵消 PDE-5 抑制剂这条禁忌。教材（Nancy）写法不同：其表格列出他达拉非（希爱力）作用持续 36–72 小时；无论按哪种写法，30 小时都在禁忌期内。

questions.questionEn: A 61-year-old woman with chest pain has received 3 doses of nitroglycerin over 15 minutes. Her pain persists and her BP is now 106/70. What is the next step?
questions.questionZh: 一名 61 岁胸痛女性在 15 分钟内已用了 3 剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），疼痛仍未缓解，目前血压 106/70。下一步是什么？

options.en: Give a fourth 0.4 mg dose of nitroglycerin now
options.zh: 马上再给第 4 剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）0.4 毫克

options.en: Give Entonox 5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin
options.zh: 末剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）后 5 分钟给 Entonox

options.en: Give a second 160 mg dose of ASA
options.zh: 再给一次阿司匹林（ASA）160 毫克

options.en: Give Entonox immediately, without waiting
options.zh: 立即给 Entonox，不用再等 5 分钟

questions.explanationEn: BC directs that if pain persists beyond 3 doses of nitroglycerin, or if the SBP falls below 110, Entonox is given 5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin dose, with assessment and vitals every 5 minutes (B). A is wrong: 3 doses is the maximum in any 30-minute period, and her SBP is now below 110. C is wrong: ASA is not repeated. D is wrong: nitroglycerin used in the last 5 minutes is a contraindication to Entonox.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定：3 剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）后疼痛仍持续，或收缩压降到 110 以下时，在最后一剂硝酸甘油 5 分钟后给 Entonox（笑气，氧化亚氮/氧气混合气），并每 5 分钟复评和测生命体征（B）。A 错：任何 30 分钟内最多 3 剂，而且她的收缩压已低于 110。C 错：阿司匹林（ASA）不重复给。D 错：5 分钟内用过硝酸甘油是 Entonox 的禁忌。

questions.questionEn: How frequently should assessment, treatment and vital signs be repeated during the cardiac chest pain protocol?
questions.questionZh: 在心源性胸痛方案执行过程中，评估、处置和生命体征应多久重复一次？

options.en: Every 15 minutes
options.zh: 每15分钟

options.en: Only on arrival and at handover
options.zh: 仅在到达时和交接时各一次

options.en: Every 20 minutes
options.zh: 每20分钟

options.en: Every 5 minutes
options.zh: 每5分钟

questions.explanationEn: The BC chest pain protocol directs continuing assessment, treatment and vital signs every 5 minutes, both when pain returns after relief and when pain persists beyond 3 nitroglycerin doses (D). A and C are wrong: intervals of 15 or 20 minutes are far too long for a possible acute coronary syndrome being treated with a vasodilator that frequently causes hypotension. B is wrong: two sets of vitals cannot detect deterioration or guide repeat nitroglycerin, which requires the SBP to stay above 110 before every dose.
questions.explanationZh: BC 胸痛方案要求每 5 分钟继续评估、处置并测量生命体征，不论是疼痛缓解后再发，还是 3 剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）后疼痛仍持续（D）。A、C 错：对可能的急性冠脉综合征患者，又在使用常引起低血压的血管扩张剂，15 或 20 分钟才测一次间隔太长。B 错：只测两次既发现不了病情恶化，也无法指导重复给硝酸甘油，因为每次给药前都要确认收缩压高于 110。

questions.questionEn: A 73-year-old man's chest pain resolved completely after 2 doses of nitroglycerin. Ten minutes later, en route, the pain returns at the same intensity. His BP is 126/78. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名 73 岁男性用了 2 剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）后胸痛完全缓解。10 分钟后在转运途中，疼痛以同样强度再次出现，血压 126/78。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Restart the nitroglycerin component; vitals every 5 minutes
options.zh: 重启硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），每 5 分钟测生命体征

options.en: Repeat both the nitroglycerin and the ASA components
options.zh: 硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）和阿司匹林（ASA）都重来

options.en: Switch to Entonox, as nitroglycerin was already used
options.zh: 改用 Entonox，因为已用过硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）

options.en: Give nothing more, as 2 doses already worked
options.zh: 不再给药，因为前 2 剂已经证明有效

questions.explanationEn: BC states that if pain is completely relieved for more than 5 minutes and then returns, the nitroglycerin component (but not the ASA component) may be re-initiated; this counts as a new episode even though nitroglycerin was given for the first one. His SBP of 126 allows it, and assessment and vitals continue every 5 minutes (A). B is wrong: ASA is not repeated. C is wrong: Entonox is for pain persisting beyond 3 nitroglycerin doses or an SBP below 110. D is wrong: recurrent ischemic pain needs treatment.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定：疼痛完全缓解超过 5 分钟后再次出现，可以重新启动硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）部分，但不重复阿司匹林（ASA）部分；即使第一次发作已经用过硝酸甘油，这也算作一次新发作。他收缩压 126，可以给药，并继续每 5 分钟评估和测生命体征（A）。B 错：阿司匹林不重复。C 错：Entonox（笑气）用于 3 剂硝酸甘油后疼痛仍持续或收缩压低于 110 时。D 错：缺血性疼痛复发必须处理。

questions.questionEn: What is the mechanism by which nitroglycerin relieves cardiac chest pain?
questions.questionZh: 硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）缓解心源性胸痛的机制是什么？

options.en: It blocks pain transmission in the spinal cord
options.zh: 阻断脊髓内的疼痛传导

options.en: It dilates vessels, lowering preload, afterload and O2 demand
options.zh: 扩张血管，降低前后负荷和心肌耗氧

options.en: It stops platelets from clumping together to form clots
options.zh: 阻止血小板聚集形成血栓

options.en: It raises heart rate and contractility to improve output
options.zh: 提高心率和收缩力以增加心输出量

questions.explanationEn: BC describes nitroglycerin as reducing cardiac oxygen demand mainly by dilating blood vessels, which decreases preload and afterload, while also dilating the coronary arteries to increase blood flow to the heart muscle (B). A is wrong: it relieves ischemic pain by improving the oxygen supply-demand balance, not by blocking pain pathways. C is wrong: preventing platelet clumping is how ASA works. D is wrong: raising heart rate and contractility is a beta-1 effect of epinephrine and would increase myocardial oxygen demand.
questions.explanationZh: BC 对硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）的描述是：主要通过扩张血管来降低心脏耗氧，减少前负荷和后负荷，同时扩张冠状动脉、增加心肌血流（B）。A 错：它缓解缺血性疼痛靠的是改善氧供需平衡，而不是阻断疼痛通路。C 错：阻止血小板聚集是阿司匹林（ASA）的作用。D 错：提高心率和收缩力是肾上腺素（epinephrine）的 β1 效应，反而会增加心肌耗氧。

questions.questionEn: A 77-year-old woman with chest pain is standing at her kitchen counter when you arrive. After the primary survey, what does the protocol direct regarding her position and movement?
questions.questionZh: 你到达时，一名77岁胸痛女性正站在厨房台面旁。完成初级评估后，方案对其体位和活动有何要求？

options.en: Have her walk to the stretcher to test her exercise tolerance
options.zh: 让她自己走到担架边，看看活动耐量

options.en: Lay her flat and elevate her legs
options.zh: 让她平躺并抬高双腿

options.en: Position of comfort, and in general limit her movement
options.zh: 取舒适体位，总体上限制她活动

options.en: Seat her with legs down and delay transport until pain-free
options.zh: 坐位双腿下垂，等不痛了再转运

questions.explanationEn: The BC chest pain protocol directs placing the patient in a position of comfort as her condition permits and, in general, limiting patient movement; transport is initiated immediately if possible, with crew delegated to prepare egress (C). A is wrong: walking raises myocardial oxygen demand and can extend ischemia. B is wrong: supine with legs raised is a shock position, not indicated here, and can worsen breathing if she has any heart failure. D is wrong: legs-down sitting is the CHF position, and transport must not wait for the pain to resolve.
questions.explanationZh: BC 胸痛方案要求在病情允许的范围内让患者取舒适体位，并总体上限制其活动；能走就立即启动转运，同时安排队员准备撤离路线（C）。A 错：走路会增加心肌耗氧，可能扩大缺血范围。B 错：平躺抬腿是休克体位，本例没有指征，如果她有心衰还会加重呼吸困难。D 错：坐位双腿下垂是心衰体位，而且转运不能等到疼痛缓解。

questions.questionEn: A 59-year-old man with chest pain has an SpO2 of 97% on room air. How should oxygen be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名59岁胸痛男性未吸氧时SpO2为97%。应如何给氧？

options.en: Non-rebreather at 15 L/min for every cardiac chest pain
options.zh: 所有心源性胸痛一律用 15 升/分非再呼吸面罩

options.en: Oxygen only if needed to keep the SpO2 at 94% or higher
options.zh: 只在需要时给氧，使 SpO2 保持 ≥94%

options.en: Nasal cannula at 6 L/min as a routine measure
options.zh: 常规用鼻导管 6 升/分

options.en: Never give oxygen, whatever the saturation
options.zh: 不论血氧多少，一律不给氧

questions.explanationEn: The BC chest pain protocol directs completing the primary survey and applying oxygen as required to maintain an SpO2 of 94% or higher; at 97% on room air no oxygen is needed (B). A is wrong: routine high-flow oxygen in a normoxic cardiac patient is not indicated. C is wrong: oxygen is not routine in chest pain; it is given only to reach the SpO2 target. D is wrong: if his SpO2 falls below 94%, or he becomes short of breath or shocked, oxygen is required.
questions.explanationZh: BC 胸痛方案要求完成初级评估，并按需给氧使 SpO2 保持在 94% 以上；他未吸氧时 97%，不需要给氧（B）。A 错：血氧正常的心脏病患者不需要常规高流量吸氧。C 错：胸痛不是常规给氧的理由，给氧只是为了达到 SpO2 目标。D 错：如果他 SpO2 降到 94% 以下，或出现气促、休克，就必须给氧。

questions.questionEn: A 71-year-old man with cardiac chest pain becomes nauseated after his second nitroglycerin dose. As a PCP, what additional intervention may be considered?
questions.questionZh: 一名 71 岁心源性胸痛男性在第 2 剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）后出现恶心。作为 PCP，可以考虑什么附加处置？

options.en: Dimenhydrinate for the nausea
options.zh: 给茶苯海明（dimenhydrinate）止吐

options.en: Withhold further nitroglycerin, as nausea is a contraindication
options.zh: 停用硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），因为恶心是禁忌证

options.en: Switch to Entonox now, as nausea means nitroglycerin failed
options.zh: 改用 Entonox（笑气），因为恶心说明硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）无效

options.en: Diphenhydramine 25–50 mg IV
options.zh: 静注苯海拉明（diphenhydramine）25–50 毫克

questions.explanationEn: The additional PCP interventions in the BC cardiac chest pain protocol are vascular access with running IV fluid and considering dimenhydrinate for nausea (1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg) (A). Nausea and vomiting are recognized adverse effects of nitroglycerin. B is wrong: nausea is not a nitroglycerin contraindication; those are SBP below 110, HR below 50 or above 150, nitrate allergy and recent PDE-5 inhibitor use. C is wrong: Entonox is for pain persisting after 3 doses or an SBP below 110, and nausea and vomiting are themselves Entonox adverse effects. D is wrong: diphenhydramine is an antihistamine for allergic reactions; the chest pain protocol names dimenhydrinate.
questions.explanationZh: BC 心源性胸痛方案中 PCP 的附加处置是建立静脉通路并输液，以及考虑用茶苯海明（dimenhydrinate）止吐（1 毫克/公斤，最大 50 毫克）（A）。恶心呕吐本来就是硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）已知的不良反应。B 错：恶心不是硝酸甘油的禁忌证，禁忌是收缩压 <110、心率 <50 或 >150、硝酸盐过敏和近期用过 PDE-5 抑制剂。C 错：Entonox（笑气，氧化亚氮/氧气混合气）用于 3 剂后疼痛仍持续或收缩压 <110，而且它本身也会引起恶心呕吐。D 错：苯海拉明（diphenhydramine）是用于过敏反应的抗组胺药，胸痛方案指定的是茶苯海明。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.47, p.63, p.65, p.73

questions.questionEn: An 83-year-old woman with chest pain has a nitroglycerin patch already applied by her family, and her BP is 132/80 with HR 78. Your partner says the protocol cannot be used because she already has nitrates on board. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 83 岁胸痛女性身上已被家人贴了硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）贴片，血压 132/80，心率 78。搭档说她体内已有硝酸盐，所以不能执行硝酸甘油方案。正确的说法是什么？

options.en: Proceed: a patch does not change the protocol
options.zh: 照常执行：贴片不影响该方案

options.en: Count the patch as one of the 3 permitted doses
options.zh: 把贴片算作允许的 3 剂之一

options.en: Remove the patch and wait 30 minutes before any SL dose
options.zh: 揭掉贴片，等 30 分钟后才能舌下给药

options.en: Do not use the protocol while a patch is in place
options.zh: 只要贴着贴片就不能用该方案

questions.explanationEn: BC states that a nitro patch already applied does not change the nitroglycerin protocol; with an SBP of 132 and HR of 78 she can receive 0.4 mg SL as indicated (A). B is wrong: the limit of 3 doses in any 30-minute period counts your sublingual doses, irrespective of any nitroglycerin the patient used before you arrived. C is wrong: BC has no rule to remove the patch and wait. D is wrong: a patch is not a contraindication.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定患者已贴的硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）贴片不改变硝酸甘油方案；她收缩压 132、心率 78，可以按指征舌下给 0.4 毫克（A）。B 错：30 分钟内最多 3 剂指的是你舌下给的剂数，与患者在你到达前用过的硝酸甘油无关。C 错：BC 没有「揭掉贴片再等待」的规定。D 错：贴片不是禁忌证。

questions.questionEn: Which medication in the BC guidelines does not require a set of vital signs prior to administration?
questions.questionZh: 在BC指南中，哪种药物在给药前不需要先测量生命体征？

options.en: Nitroglycerin
options.zh: 硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）

options.en: Entonox
options.zh: Entonox（笑气，氧化亚氮/氧气混合气）

options.en: Aspirin (ASA)
options.zh: 阿司匹林（ASA）

options.en: Epinephrine
options.zh: 肾上腺素（epinephrine）

questions.explanationEn: BC states that ASA is the only medication for which vital signs are not required before administration, although it is still given after the rapid body survey and only once its contraindications and cautions have been checked (C). A is wrong: nitroglycerin requires an SBP above 110 and an HR of 50–150 before each dose. B is wrong: Entonox requires a baseline set of vitals including oxygen saturation. D is wrong: ASA is the only stated exception; in the anaphylaxis protocol, epinephrine follows the primary survey and a baseline set of vitals.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定阿司匹林（ASA）是唯一一种给药前不要求先测生命体征的药物，但仍要在快速全身检查之后给，并先核对禁忌证和注意事项（C）。A 错：硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）每次给药前都要确认收缩压 >110、心率 50–150。B 错：Entonox（笑气，氧化亚氮/氧气混合气）要求先获得包括血氧饱和度在内的基线生命体征。D 错：BC 只把阿司匹林列为例外；过敏性休克方案中，肾上腺素（epinephrine）是在初级评估和基线生命体征之后给的。

questions.questionEn: A 60-year-old man with chest pain received 3 doses of nitroglycerin and has been on Entonox for the 20 minutes since. His pain persists, BP 128/80, HR 84, and hospital arrival is not imminent. What does the guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 60 岁胸痛男性已用过 3 剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），之后吸入 Entonox（笑气）已 20 分钟。疼痛仍在，血压 128/80，心率 84，短时间内到不了医院。指南要求怎么做？

options.en: Continue Entonox for the rest of the transport time
options.zh: 转运全程继续吸 Entonox，不作调整

options.en: Stop Entonox, resume high-flow O2, give more nitro
options.zh: 停 Entonox，恢复高流量氧，追加硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）

options.en: Give a second 160 mg dose of ASA for the pain
options.zh: 再给一次阿司匹林（ASA）160 毫克止痛

options.en: Give nitroglycerin while he keeps using Entonox
options.zh: 边吸 Entonox 边给硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）

questions.explanationEn: BC states that if nitroglycerin has been given and Entonox is now in use, and hospital arrival is not imminent 20 minutes after the last nitroglycerin, Entonox is discontinued, high-flow oxygen resumed, and additional nitroglycerin given as per protocol; the chest pain protocol may be repeated 30 minutes after the first nitroglycerin dose once nitrous oxide has been stopped for 5 minutes, provided the SBP stays above 110 (B). A is wrong: Entonox is not simply continued when arrival is not imminent. C is wrong: ASA is not repeated. D is wrong: the two are not used together; nitroglycerin within 5 minutes is an Entonox contraindication, and nitrous oxide must be off for 5 minutes before nitroglycerin is restarted.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定：已给过硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）、正在使用 Entonox（笑气），而在最后一剂硝酸甘油 20 分钟后仍不能很快到院时，应停用 Entonox，恢复高流量给氧，并按方案追加硝酸甘油；首剂硝酸甘油 30 分钟后、停用氧化亚氮满 5 分钟，就可重复胸痛方案，前提是收缩压保持在 110 以上（B）。A 错：到院不近时，不能一直吸 Entonox。C 错：阿司匹林（ASA）不重复。D 错：两者不能同时用；5 分钟内用过硝酸甘油是 Entonox 的禁忌，重新给硝酸甘油前也要先停氧化亚氮 5 分钟。

questions.questionEn: A frail 86-year-old woman with chest pain is about to receive her first nitroglycerin dose while sitting on the edge of her bed. Which caution is most important?
questions.questionZh: 一名体弱的 86 岁胸痛女性坐在床沿，即将接受第一剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）。最重要的注意事项是什么？

options.en: Expect bradycardia and keep atropine on standby
options.zh: 预计会心动过缓，备好阿托品（atropine）

options.en: Expect hypotension and make sure she cannot fall
options.zh: 预计会低血压，确保她不会跌倒

options.en: Shake the nitroglycerin spray well before use
options.zh: 使用前把硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）喷雾用力摇匀

options.en: Halve the dose because she is over 80
options.zh: 她已超过 80 岁，剂量减半

questions.explanationEn: BC warns that hypotension frequently occurs with nitroglycerin, especially in the elderly, and must be expected: ensure the patient is not at risk of falling, so have her lie back or be well supported rather than perched on the edge of the bed (B). A is wrong: bradycardia is not the listed concern, and atropine is not among the BC drugs for this protocol. C is wrong: BC says not to shake the nitroglycerin spray before use. D is wrong: BC sets no age-based dose reduction.
questions.explanationZh: BC 提醒：硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）常引起低血压，老年人尤其明显，必须预先想到，并确保患者没有跌倒风险，所以要让她靠躺或有人扶稳，而不是坐在床沿（B）。A 错：心动过缓不是 BC 列出的主要风险，阿托品（atropine）也不在本方案的 BC 药物之列。C 错：BC 明确说硝酸甘油喷雾使用前不要摇。D 错：BC 没有按年龄减量的规定。

questions.questionEn: A 62-year-old man with cardiac chest pain has a heart rate of 158 and a BP of 118/76. What is the correct decision about nitroglycerin?
questions.questionZh: 一名 62 岁心源性胸痛男性心率 158，血压 118/76。关于硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），正确的决定是什么？

options.en: Withhold it: a heart rate above 150 is a contraindication
options.zh: 不给：心率高于 150 是禁忌证

options.en: Give it, since the systolic BP is above 110 mmHg
options.zh: 给，因为收缩压高于 110

options.en: Give it only after a second dose of ASA
options.zh: 再给一次阿司匹林（ASA）后才能给

options.en: Give a double dose to counter the tachycardia
options.zh: 给双倍剂量来对抗心动过速

questions.explanationEn: BC contraindicates nitroglycerin when the heart rate is below 50 or above 150, as well as with an SBP below 110, nitrate allergy or recent PDE-5 inhibitor use (A). The rest of the protocol still applies, and Entonox is indicated for cardiac chest pain when nitroglycerin is contraindicated. B is wrong: the SBP is only one of several criteria. C is wrong: ASA is not repeated and has no bearing on nitroglycerin eligibility. D is wrong: there is no double dose; the tachycardia is the reason to withhold. Textbook (Nancy) wording differs: it uses a heart rate above 160 as the cut-off, whereas BC uses 150, so at 158 the BC rule applies.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定心率低于 50 或高于 150 时禁用硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），收缩压 <110、硝酸盐过敏、近期用过 PDE-5 抑制剂也都是禁忌（A）。胸痛方案其余部分照常执行，而且硝酸甘油禁用时，Entonox（笑气，氧化亚氮/氧气混合气）正是心源性胸痛的适应药物。B 错：收缩压只是几项标准之一。C 错：阿司匹林（ASA）不重复，也不影响能否用硝酸甘油。D 错：没有双倍剂量一说，心动过速本身就是不给的理由。教材（Nancy）写法不同：以心率高于 160 为界，而 BC 用 150，所以心率 158 时按 BC 规则不给。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.65, p.73; Nancy Ch 30

questions.questionEn: Under the cardiac chest pain protocol, at what point should transport be initiated?
questions.questionZh: 按心源性胸痛方案，应在什么时候启动转运？

options.en: Only after the patient is pain-free
options.zh: 等患者完全不痛之后

options.en: Only after all three nitroglycerin doses are given
options.zh: 等三剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）全部给完之后

options.en: Immediately if able; at the latest after the first nitro dose
options.zh: 能走就立即走，最迟在第一剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）后

options.en: Only after vascular access has been established
options.zh: 等静脉通路建立之后

questions.explanationEn: The BC chest pain protocol directs initiating transport immediately if able (delegating crew members to prepare egress if not), and transporting after the first dose of nitroglycerin if that has not already happened (C). A and B are wrong: on-scene time should not be extended to achieve pain relief or complete the drug sequence; nitroglycerin continues en route. D is wrong: vascular access is an additional PCP intervention that must not delay transport.
questions.explanationZh: BC 胸痛方案要求能走就立即启动转运（不能马上走时，安排队员准备撤离路线），如果还没出发，至少在第一剂硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）后转运（C）。A、B 错：不能为了止痛或给完全部药物而延长现场时间，硝酸甘油可在途中继续给。D 错：建立静脉通路是 PCP 的附加处置，不能因此延误转运。

questions.questionEn: A 54-year-old man with chest pain tells you he took two of his own nitroglycerin tablets before you arrived, with no relief. His BP is 124/76 and HR 84. How many doses may you administer?
questions.questionZh: 一名 54 岁胸痛男性说，你到达前他已自己含了两片硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），没有缓解。血压 124/76，心率 84。你最多可以给几剂？

options.en: One dose only, since he has already had two
options.zh: 只能给一剂，因为他已经用过两片

options.en: None, as his own nitroglycerin blocks the protocol
options.zh: 一剂都不能给，自行用药后不能再执行方案

options.en: Up to 3 in any 30 minutes, not counting his own doses
options.zh: 30 分钟内最多 3 剂，不计他自己用的

options.en: Unlimited doses as long as the pain continues
options.zh: 只要还痛，就不限剂数

questions.explanationEn: BC repeats vitals and nitroglycerin until pain is relieved, to a maximum of 3 doses in any 30-minute period, provided the SBP stays above 110, irrespective of any nitroglycerin the patient took before you arrived (C). A and B are wrong: the patient's own doses are not counted against your limit. D is wrong: the limit is 3 doses in any 30-minute period. Note that ASA works differently: if the patient has already taken the recommended ASA dose, ASA is contraindicated.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定重复测生命体征并给硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin），直到疼痛缓解，任何 30 分钟内最多 3 剂，前提是收缩压保持在 110 以上，而且不计患者在你到达前自己用过的硝酸甘油（C）。A、B 错：患者自己用的剂数不计入你的限额。D 错：上限是任何 30 分钟内 3 剂。注意阿司匹林（ASA）规则不同：患者已自行服用推荐剂量的，就禁用阿司匹林。

questions.questionEn: A 31-year-old man has a deep forearm laceration bleeding briskly after a workshop accident. What is your first hemorrhage control measure?
questions.questionZh: 一名31岁男性在车间事故中前臂深度撕裂伤，出血迅猛。你的第一项止血措施是什么？

options.en: Apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound immediately
options.zh: 立即在伤口近端上止血带

options.en: Pack the wound with hemostatic gauze
options.zh: 用止血纱布填塞伤口

options.en: Apply a cold pack and elevate the limb
options.zh: 冷敷并抬高患肢

options.en: Expose the wound and apply firm direct pressure
options.zh: 暴露伤口并用力直接压迫

questions.explanationEn: In the primary survey, BC directs exposing and examining the wound, then controlling major hemorrhage with direct pressure; the order of preference is direct pressure, pressure dressing, elevating the part, positioning the patient, tourniquet, then extremity wound packing (D). A is wrong: a tourniquet is used when direct pressure fails to control bleeding in an area amenable to one. B is wrong: packing is the last resort, for junctional bleeding or extremity bleeding that cannot otherwise be controlled. C is wrong: elevation is only an adjunct to pressure, and cold belongs to the treatment component for injuries, not to controlling brisk bleeding.
questions.explanationZh: 在初级评估中，BC 要求先暴露并检查伤口，再用直接压迫控制大出血；止血方法的优先顺序是：直接压迫→加压包扎→抬高患部→摆放患者体位→止血带→肢体伤口填塞（D）。A 错：止血带用于直接压迫无法控制、且部位适合上止血带的出血。B 错：填塞是最后手段，用于交界部位出血或其他方法控制不了的肢体出血。C 错：抬高只是压迫的辅助，冷敷属于伤处的后续处理，不是用来控制迅猛出血的。

questions.questionEn: A 10-year-old boy has an arterial bleed from a mid-thigh laceration. Direct pressure and a pressure dressing have failed to control it. What is the next step?
questions.questionZh: 一名10岁男孩大腿中段撕裂伤伴动脉性出血。直接压迫和加压包扎均未能控制出血。下一步是什么？

options.en: Pack the thigh wound and bandage over the packing
options.zh: 填塞大腿伤口，再在上面加压包扎

options.en: Elevate the limb and wait 5 minutes before reassessing
options.zh: 抬高患肢，等 5 分钟再评估

options.en: Transport now without further bleeding control
options.zh: 立即转运，不再做其他止血

options.en: Apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound
options.zh: 在伤口近端上止血带

questions.explanationEn: BC directs that if direct pressure does not control the bleeding and the wound is in an area amenable to a tourniquet, a tourniquet is applied proximal to the wound, with the time noted (D). A is wrong: packing is for junctional bleeding where a tourniquet cannot be applied, and a mid-thigh wound can take one. B is wrong: elevation is weaker than the direct pressure that has already failed, and waiting allows ongoing arterial loss. C is wrong: major hemorrhage must be controlled in the primary survey, not left for the hospital.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定：直接压迫控制不住出血、而伤口位于适合上止血带的部位时，在伤口近端上止血带并记录时间（D）。A 错：填塞用于无法上止血带的交界部位出血，大腿中段是可以上止血带的。B 错：抬高的效果不如已经失败的直接压迫，再等 5 分钟只会让动脉出血继续。C 错：大出血必须在初级评估中控制，不能留给医院。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old man on warfarin has a deep laceration on the side of his neck, above the clavicle, that keeps bleeding despite gloved direct pressure. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名 72 岁、正在服用华法林（warfarin）的男性颈侧锁骨上方有一处深裂伤，戴手套直接压迫后仍持续出血。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Pack the wound firmly, since a tourniquet cannot be used there
options.zh: 用力填塞伤口，因为这里不能上止血带

options.en: Wrap a pressure bandage firmly around the neck
options.zh: 用加压绷带在颈部绕圈扎紧

options.en: Release pressure every minute to check whether it has stopped
options.zh: 每分钟松开一次，看出血是否已止

options.en: Seal it with an occlusive dressing and keep firm manual pressure
options.zh: 用封闭敷料封住伤口，并持续用手用力压迫

questions.explanationEn: BC considers wound packing for junctional bleeding that cannot take a tourniquet, but states explicitly: do not pack wounds on the neck, chest or abdomen. The neck wound is managed with continued firm direct pressure, and the textbook adds an occlusive dressing to prevent air embolism, with manual pressure over a bulky dressing (D). A is wrong: BC prohibits packing neck wounds. B is wrong: a circumferential bandage around the neck can compress both carotid arteries and the airway and must never be used. C is wrong: repeatedly releasing pressure disrupts clot formation, which is already impaired by warfarin.
questions.explanationZh: BC 允许对无法上止血带的交界部位出血考虑填塞，但明确规定：颈部、胸部和腹部的伤口不得填塞。颈部伤口应持续用力直接压迫，教材还要求先用封闭敷料封住伤口以防空气栓塞，再在厚敷料上用手压迫（D）。A 错：BC 禁止填塞颈部伤口。B 错：绕颈加压包扎可能同时压迫两侧颈动脉和气道，绝不能用。C 错：反复松开压迫会破坏血凝块形成，而华法林本来就削弱了凝血。

questions.questionEn: You applied a tourniquet 12 minutes ago to a 14-year-old's forearm and the bleeding has stopped. Transport time is 25 minutes. What should you do with the tourniquet?
questions.questionZh: 你在12分钟前给一名14岁患者的前臂上了止血带，出血已经停止。转运时间还需25分钟。止血带应该如何处理？

options.en: Release it every 10 minutes to let the limb perfuse
options.zh: 每 10 分钟松开一次，让肢体获得灌注

options.en: Release it now, and reapply it if bleeding restarts
options.zh: 现在松开，再出血时重新上

options.en: Loosen it slightly to ease pain, without fully releasing
options.zh: 稍微放松以减轻疼痛，但不完全松开

options.en: Leave it on, with the time noted, and do not release it
options.zh: 记录时间后保持原样，不得松开

questions.explanationEn: BC directs noting the time of tourniquet application and not releasing it once applied; the textbook likewise leaves loosening to hospital staff who are ready to manage the bleeding (D). A is wrong: periodic release is outdated practice and causes repeated blood loss. B is wrong: releasing it risks renewed catastrophic hemorrhage. C is wrong: a partly loosened tourniquet no longer reliably stops arterial flow, so bleeding can restart; a tourniquet that is working should not be adjusted except to tighten it if bleeding resumes.
questions.explanationZh: BC 要求记录上止血带的时间，一旦上好就不得松开；教材同样写明要由准备好处理出血的医院人员来松开（D）。A 错：定时放松是过时做法，会导致反复失血。B 错：松开可能引起再次大出血。C 错：放松一部分后，止血带就不再可靠地阻断动脉血流，出血可能重新开始；有效的止血带不应再调松，只有再出血时才需要拧紧。

questions.questionEn: What is the dose and administration of tranexamic acid (TXA) under the BC guidelines?
questions.questionZh: 按 BC 指南，氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）的剂量和给药方法是什么？

options.en: 1 gram IV push over 10 seconds
options.zh: 1克静脉推注，10秒内推完

options.en: 2 grams (2000 mg) IV push over 1 minute
options.zh: 2克（2000毫克）静脉推注，1分钟内推完

options.en: 1 gram IM, repeated once after 30 minutes
options.zh: 肌注1克，30分钟后重复一次

options.en: 20 mg/kg IV infused over 20 minutes
options.zh: 20毫克/公斤静脉输注，20分钟输完

questions.explanationEn: BC gives TXA as 2 grams (2000 mg) IV push over 1 minute; its listed caution is further hypotension if it is given too quickly (B). A is wrong: 1 gram is half the BC dose, and pushing it over 10 seconds is too fast. C is wrong: BC gives TXA by IV push, not IM, and does not repeat it. D is wrong: there is no weight-based TXA dose in BC; patients under 12 years are a contraindication.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）2 克（2000 毫克）静脉推注，1 分钟推完；列出的注意事项是推得太快会加重低血压（B）。A 错：1 克是 BC 剂量的一半，10 秒推完也太快。C 错：BC 用静脉推注而不是肌注，也不重复给药。D 错：BC 没有按体重计算的 TXA 剂量，12 岁以下患者属于禁忌。

questions.questionEn: A 9-year-old girl struck by a car has signs of shock with ongoing internal bleeding suspected. The hypovolemia protocol has been initiated. What about TXA?
questions.questionZh: 一名 9 岁女孩被汽车撞伤，有休克表现，怀疑持续内出血，低血容量方案已启动。氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）该怎么处理？

options.en: Give 1 g IV, half the adult dose, adjusted for her age
options.zh: 按年龄调整，静脉给 1 克，即成人剂量的一半

options.en: Give the full 2 g adult dose
options.zh: 按成人剂量给足 2 克

options.en: Give TXA only if the injury was over 3 hours ago
options.zh: 只有受伤超过 3 小时才给 TXA

options.en: Withhold TXA: under 12 years is a contraindication
options.zh: 不给 TXA：12 岁以下属于禁忌

questions.explanationEn: BC's TXA contraindications are known hypersensitivity, more than 3 hours since injury, age under 12 years, and isolated traumatic brain injury (D). There is no reduced paediatric dose; the drug is simply not given under 12. Continue the hypovolemia protocol: control hemorrhage, position supine, keep her warm, give oxygen, and obtain vascular access with a 20 mL/kg bolus en route. A and B are wrong because any TXA dose is contraindicated at her age. C is wrong: it reverses the time rule; TXA is contraindicated beyond 3 hours, not required.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）的禁忌证是：已知过敏、受伤超过 3 小时、年龄小于 12 岁，以及孤立性颅脑损伤（D）。没有儿童减量方案，12 岁以下就是不用。应继续执行低血容量方案：控制出血、仰卧、保暖、给氧，并在途中建立静脉通路、按 20 毫升/公斤推注液体。A、B 错：她这个年龄任何剂量都属禁忌。C 错：把时间规则说反了，超过 3 小时是禁忌，而不是给药条件。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old man fell down stairs and was found by family 4 hours later. He has a rigid abdomen, BP 84/58 and HR 122. The hypovolemia protocol is under way. What about TXA?
questions.questionZh: 一名 68 岁男性从楼梯上摔下，4 小时后才被家人发现。腹部板状强直，血压 84/58，心率 122，正在执行低血容量方案。氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）该怎么处理？

options.en: Give 2 g IV push over 1 minute, as he is clearly in shock
options.zh: 他明显休克，静脉推注 2 克，1 分钟推完

options.en: Give 2 g as a slow infusion over 30 minutes instead
options.zh: 改为 30 分钟内缓慢静滴 2 克

options.en: Give 1 g IV push as a compromise for the delay
options.zh: 考虑到延误，折中静推 1 克

options.en: Withhold TXA: it is contraindicated beyond 3 hours
options.zh: 不给 TXA：受伤超过 3 小时属于禁忌

questions.explanationEn: BC contraindicates TXA when more than 3 hours have passed since the injury; he was found 4 hours after the fall (D). Continue the hypovolemia protocol: control any external bleeding, position supine, keep him warm, give oxygen to SpO2 94% or higher, and obtain vascular access with 20 mL/kg boluses en route, reassessing every 500 mL. A is wrong: shock alone does not override the time contraindication. B and C are wrong: changing the rate or the dose does not make TXA permissible after 3 hours.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定受伤超过 3 小时禁用氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）；他是摔倒 4 小时后才被发现的（D）。应继续执行低血容量方案：控制外出血、仰卧、保暖、给氧使 SpO2 ≥94%，途中建立静脉通路并按 20 毫升/公斤推注，每 500 毫升复评一次。A 错：仅凭休克不能抵消时间禁忌。B、C 错：改变推注速度或剂量，都不能让超过 3 小时的 TXA 变得可以使用。

questions.questionEn: A 27-year-old man assaulted with a bat has an isolated head injury: GCS 10, a boggy scalp hematoma, BP 148/92, HR 62, no other injuries found on the rapid body survey. Your partner suggests TXA. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 27 岁男性被球棒击打，为孤立性头部损伤：GCS 10 分，头皮有波动性血肿，血压 148/92，心率 62，快速全身检查未见其他损伤。搭档建议给氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）。正确的判断是什么？

options.en: Give TXA, as head bleeding is the most dangerous kind
options.zh: 给 TXA，因为头部出血最危险

options.en: Give TXA only after a fluid bolus raises the BP
options.zh: 先补液升压，再给 TXA

options.en: Withhold TXA: isolated TBI is a contraindication
options.zh: 不给 TXA：孤立性颅脑损伤是禁忌证

options.en: Give half the dose because he is hypertensive
options.zh: 他血压偏高，只给半量

questions.explanationEn: BC lists isolated traumatic brain injury as a contraindication to TXA, and he has no indication anyway: TXA is for major trauma after starting the hypovolemia protocol, or for shock with a mechanism or findings suggesting occult or ongoing bleeding (C). His hypertension with a slow pulse points to rising intracranial pressure, not hypovolemia. BC TBI care is SpO2 94% or higher, head of the bed at 30 degrees, a loosened collar, and for PCPs a glucose of 4–8 mmol/L and an SBP above 120. A is wrong: TXA is contraindicated in isolated TBI. B is wrong: he is hypertensive, so no bolus is indicated, and a bolus would not remove the contraindication. D is wrong: BC has no half dose.
questions.explanationZh: BC 把孤立性颅脑损伤列为氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）的禁忌证，而且他本来就没有适应证：TXA 用于启动低血容量方案后的严重创伤患者，或有休克表现且受伤机制/体征提示隐匿或持续出血的患者（C）。他血压高、脉搏慢，提示颅内压升高，而不是低血容量。BC 的颅脑损伤处理是：SpO2 ≥94%、床头抬高 30 度、放松颈托，PCP 还要维持血糖 4–8 mmol/L、收缩压 >120。A 错：孤立性颅脑损伤禁用 TXA。B 错：他血压偏高，不需要补液，补液也去不掉禁忌。D 错：BC 没有半量用法。

questions.questionEn: A 12-year-old girl has a grossly deformed mid-shaft femur fracture with no palpable pulse in the foot. Bleeding is controlled. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名12岁女孩股骨干中段骨折伴明显畸形，足背触不到脉搏，出血已控制。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Splint the limb as found and transport without realignment
options.zh: 按原样固定，不复位就转运

options.en: Apply a tourniquet above the fracture to protect the limb
options.zh: 在骨折上方上止血带保护肢体

options.en: Make repeated realignment attempts until a pulse returns
options.zh: 反复尝试复位，直到摸到脉搏

options.en: Make one attempt to realign it to the anatomical position
options.zh: 尝试一次，把肢体复位到解剖位

questions.explanationEn: BC states that if a limb is pulseless distal to an injury, one attempt can be made to realign it to the anatomical position; if circulation returns the patient can be treated as stable, and if the limb stays pulseless she is managed as unstable (D). A is wrong: grossly deformed or pulseless limbs are realigned in the primary survey, because absent distal circulation may mean a limb-threatening injury. B is wrong: a tourniquet is for uncontrolled hemorrhage; the bleeding is controlled, and a tourniquet would make the ischemia worse. C is wrong: BC allows only one attempt, and repeated manipulation risks further neurovascular injury.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定：损伤远端摸不到脉搏时，可尝试一次把肢体复位到解剖位；循环恢复就按稳定患者处理，仍无脉搏则按不稳定患者处理（D）。A 错：明显畸形或无脉的肢体要在初级评估中复位，因为远端循环消失可能意味着危及肢体的损伤。B 错：止血带用于控制不住的大出血；出血已经控制，再上止血带只会加重缺血。C 错：BC 只允许尝试一次，反复搬动可能进一步损伤神经血管。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old woman fell at home and has an unstable pelvis, BP 86/54, HR 118, pale cool skin. External bleeding is controlled and the pelvis has been bound. How should she be positioned and protected?
questions.questionZh: 一名79岁女性在家跌倒，骨盆不稳定，血压86/54，心率118，皮肤苍白湿冷。外出血已控制且骨盆已固定。应如何摆放体位并做好防护？

options.en: Sitting upright with her legs hung down
options.zh: 端坐位，双腿下垂

options.en: Semi-prone on her left side, knees bent
options.zh: 左侧半俯卧位，双膝弯曲

options.en: Prone, with her head turned to one side
options.zh: 俯卧位，头偏向一侧

options.en: Supine and kept warm, with oxygen
options.zh: 仰卧、保暖，并给氧

questions.explanationEn: BC hypovolemia care at all licence levels is to control external hemorrhage, splint the pelvis or fractures, position the patient supine to support blood pressure, keep her warm and protect her from further heat loss, and give oxygen to keep SpO2 at 94% or higher (D); en route, a PCP obtains vascular access, gives 20 mL/kg boluses reassessing every 500 mL, and considers TXA within 3 hours of injury. A is wrong: sitting with the legs down reduces venous return and worsens hypotension; it is the CHF position. B is wrong: semi-prone positioning is for airway protection with a decreased LOC, and rolling her moves an unstable pelvis. C is wrong: prone positioning hinders breathing and assessment.
questions.explanationZh: BC 各级执照的低血容量处理是：控制外出血，固定骨盆或骨折，仰卧以支持血压，保暖防止热量继续丢失，给氧使 SpO2 ≥94%（D）；PCP 在途中建立静脉通路，按 20 毫升/公斤推注、每 500 毫升复评，受伤 3 小时内可考虑氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）。A 错：坐位双腿下垂会减少静脉回流、加重低血压，那是心衰体位。B 错：半俯卧位用于意识下降时保护气道，而且翻身会搬动不稳定的骨盆。C 错：俯卧妨碍呼吸，也不便评估。

questions.questionEn: An 81-year-old man was ejected from a rolled vehicle. He has a flail segment, an open femur fracture and BP 112/70 with HR 98. Your partner says the hypovolemia protocol does not apply because his systolic is above 90. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名81岁男性在车辆翻滚中被抛出车外，有连枷胸段、股骨开放性骨折，血压112/70，心率98。搭档说收缩压高于90，因此低血容量方案不适用。正确的判断是什么？

options.en: Use it: shock is anticipated from the mechanism and injuries
options.zh: 可以用：根据机制和伤情预计会发生休克

options.en: Do not use it: the protocol requires a systolic below 90
options.zh: 不能用：该方案要求收缩压低于 90

options.en: Wait for a second set of vitals showing hypotension
options.zh: 等第二组生命体征出现低血压再说

options.en: Use it only once the heart rate exceeds 120
options.zh: 心率超过 120 后才启用

questions.explanationEn: A footnote to the BC hypovolemia protocol states that it may be used for patients with a BP above 90 mmHg if shock is anticipated because of the mechanism of injury, the nature and extent of the injuries, or the patient's condition; ejection, a flail segment and an open femur fracture clearly qualify (A). B is wrong: it ignores that footnote. C is wrong: waiting for hypotension in a multi-system trauma patient means acting late. D is wrong: a heart-rate threshold is not a BC criterion, and older adults may not mount a marked tachycardia.
questions.explanationZh: BC 低血容量方案的脚注写明：若根据受伤机制、损伤性质和范围或患者状况预计会发生休克，血压高于 90 毫米汞柱也可使用该方案；被抛出车外、连枷胸段加股骨开放性骨折显然属于这种情况（A）。B 错：忽略了这条脚注。C 错：多系统创伤患者等到出现低血压再处理就晚了。D 错：心率阈值不是 BC 的标准，而且老年人未必会出现明显的心动过速。

questions.questionEn: A 15-year-old boy with a stab wound to the thigh has BP 88/56, HR 128 and pale clammy skin. Bleeding is controlled with a tourniquet. As a PCP, when should vascular access and fluid be obtained?
questions.questionZh: 一名15岁男孩大腿刺伤，血压88/56，心率128，皮肤苍白湿冷，已用止血带控制出血。作为PCP，应在什么时候建立血管通路并输液？

options.en: On scene before packaging, so the bolus is in before moving
options.zh: 在现场打包前完成，搬动前把液体输完

options.en: Only after arrival at hospital
options.zh: 到医院后才做

options.en: Before the hemorrhage is controlled
options.zh: 在控制出血之前

options.en: En route (or during a delay), after bleeding control
options.zh: 控制出血后，在转运途中（或遇延误时）进行

questions.explanationEn: BC places the additional PCP hypovolemia interventions en route or during a time delay: obtain vascular access, consider a fluid bolus of 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 L reassessing every 500 mL, and consider TXA (D). A is wrong: starting the IV and bolus on scene extends scene time for a patient who needs surgery. B is wrong: a PCP should not leave vascular access to the hospital when it can be done en route. C is wrong: hemorrhage control is a primary-survey priority and comes first.
questions.explanationZh: BC 把 PCP 的低血容量附加处置安排在转运途中或遇到延误时进行：建立静脉通路，考虑 20 毫升/公斤（最多 2 升、每 500 毫升复评）的液体推注，并考虑氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）（D）。A 错：在现场建立静脉通路和输液，会延长需要手术的患者的现场时间。B 错：途中能做的静脉通路，PCP 不应留给医院。C 错：控制出血是初级评估的优先事项，必须先做。

questions.questionEn: A 30 kg 9-year-old in hypovolemic shock is receiving a fluid bolus. What volume constitutes the correct bolus, and how often should you reassess?
questions.questionZh: 一名30公斤重的9岁低血容量休克患儿正在接受液体推注。正确的推注量是多少，多久复评一次？

options.en: 300 mL (10 mL/kg), reassessing at the end
options.zh: 300 毫升（10 毫升/公斤），输完再评估

options.en: 1500 mL (50 mL/kg), reassessing every 500 mL
options.zh: 1500 毫升（50 毫升/公斤），每 500 毫升复评

options.en: 2000 mL (the maximum), reassessing at the end
options.zh: 2000 毫升（上限量），输完再评估

options.en: 600 mL (20 mL/kg), reassessing every 500 mL
options.zh: 600 毫升（20 毫升/公斤），每 500 毫升复评

questions.explanationEn: BC's fluid bolus is 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 mL: 30 kg × 20 mL = 600 mL (D). A is wrong: 300 mL is only 10 mL/kg, and reassessment belongs at every 500 mL, not just at the end. B is wrong: 1500 mL is 50 mL/kg, well beyond the bolus. C is wrong: 2 litres is the maximum cap, not the bolus for a 30 kg child, and skipping reassessment risks over-resuscitation.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的液体推注方案是 20 毫升/公斤，最多 2 升，每 500 毫升复评一次：30 公斤 × 20 毫升 = 600 毫升（D）。A 错：300 毫升只有 10 毫升/公斤，而且应每 500 毫升复评，而不是输完才评。B 错：1500 毫升相当于 50 毫升/公斤，远超推注量。C 错：2 升是上限，不是 30 公斤儿童的推注量，不复评还有补液过量的风险。

questions.questionEn: A 13-year-old with multiple injuries and signs of shock has an open abdominal wound with a loop of bowel protruding. How should the eviscerated bowel be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名13岁多发伤患者有休克表现，腹部开放伤口有一段肠管脱出。脱出的肠管应如何处理？

options.en: Gently replace it in the abdomen and bandage firmly
options.zh: 轻轻放回腹腔，再加压包扎

options.en: Cover with moist sterile dressings, then an occlusive layer
options.zh: 用湿润无菌敷料覆盖，外加一层封闭敷料

options.en: Pack the abdominal wound to control bleeding
options.zh: 填塞腹部伤口以止血

options.en: Apply a dry pressure dressing directly over the bowel
options.zh: 直接在肠管上加干性加压敷料

questions.explanationEn: BC directs covering extruded bowel or eviscerated abdominal contents with moist, sterile dressings followed by an occlusive layer, and not placing them back in the abdomen (B). Also control external hemorrhage, limit movement, protect against heat loss and transport; en route a PCP obtains vascular access and considers TXA, which is permitted at 13 years. A is wrong: replacing the bowel risks infection and further injury. C is wrong: BC states that abdominal wounds must not be packed. D is wrong: dry dressings stick to and dry out the bowel, and pressure can injure it.
questions.explanationZh: BC 要求用湿润的无菌敷料覆盖脱出的肠管或腹腔内容物，外加一层封闭敷料，不要放回腹腔（B）。同时控制外出血、限制活动、防止热量丢失并转运；PCP 在途中建立静脉通路，并可考虑氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA），13 岁可以使用。A 错：放回腹腔有感染和进一步损伤的风险。C 错：BC 明确规定腹部伤口不得填塞。D 错：干敷料会粘住肠管并使其干燥，加压还可能造成损伤。

questions.questionEn: A 66-year-old woman thrown from a horse 40 minutes ago has BP 88/60, HR 124, a rigid abdomen and no external bleeding. The hypovolemia protocol has been initiated and vascular access obtained. What is correct regarding tranexamic acid (TXA)?
questions.questionZh: 一名 66 岁女性 40 分钟前从马背上摔下，血压 88/60，心率 124，腹部板状强直，没有外出血。低血容量方案已启动，静脉通路已建立。关于氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA），正确的做法是什么？

options.en: Withhold TXA, since there is no external bleeding
options.zh: 不给 TXA，因为没有外出血

options.en: Give TXA only if 2 L of fluid fails to raise the BP
options.zh: 补液 2 升仍不升压才给 TXA

options.en: Give TXA 1 g over 10 minutes, then 1 g over 8 hours
options.zh: TXA 先 10 分钟给 1 克，再 8 小时给 1 克

options.en: Give TXA 2 g IV push over 1 minute
options.zh: TXA 2 克静脉推注，1 分钟推完

questions.explanationEn: BC indicates TXA for major trauma after the hypovolemia protocol has been initiated and for shock with a mechanism or findings suggestive of occult or ongoing bleeding; the hypovolemia protocol specifically lists hypovolemia secondary to occult bleeding. She is within 3 hours of injury, over 12 years old and has no isolated TBI, so the dose is 2 g IV push over 1 minute (D). A is wrong: occult internal bleeding is exactly what TXA is meant for. B is wrong: BC does not require fluids to fail before TXA. C is wrong: BC gives a single 2 g IV push, not a split-dose infusion regimen.
questions.explanationZh: BC 规定氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid，TXA）适用于已启动低血容量方案的严重创伤患者，以及有休克表现且受伤机制或体征提示隐匿或持续出血的患者；低血容量方案也特别列出了隐匿性出血导致的低血容量。她受伤在 3 小时内、超过 12 岁、没有孤立性颅脑损伤，剂量为 2 克静脉推注，1 分钟推完（D）。A 错：隐匿性内出血正是 TXA 的用武之地。B 错：BC 并不要求补液失败后才给 TXA。C 错：BC 是一次性静推 2 克，不是分两次的输注方案。
